name: examen-marketplace
description: One-plugin marketplace hosting examen, a tag-based response-format protocol.

plugins.name: examen
plugins.description: Tag a message (y: t: d: p: m: o: r: h: g: e: x: %: a: 1: s: k: i: v: ?:, plus modifiers ! ^ @ ~ %) and get the answer in exactly that format.
